title: Factory caller marker
description: One caller marker file, .factory/local/hooks/calls/<key>.json, written by the hook runner before it lets a vsdd call through (hooks.md 2.11.10; record caller-marker). The tool reads it back with vsdd.state.callers.caller and deletes it on read; the runner only writes it. The file is staged as <state>/local/hooks/tmp/<key>.json.tmp and renamed into calls/, so a reader never sees half of one and a kill before the rename leaves nothing in calls/ for the prune to miss. Unread markers older than ten minutes are pruned by the reader.

key.description: The one-time key, 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters (secrets.token_hex(16)); also the file name and the VSDD_CALLER value of the rewritten command. Exactly 32 characters is enforced here; the character set by the writer.

agent_id.description: The calling agent's id, empty for the main session.

agent_type.description: The calling agent's type, empty for the main session, vsdd-factory:<name> for a plugin agent, workflow-subagent for a workflow step.

cwd.description: The working directory the payload carried.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision, the event log's form.
